hunks.baseline: Just a few years ago, I’d been living a life that had nothing to do with those four words.
hunks.sol: Just a few years ago, my life couldn’t have been further from the meaning of those four words.

hunks.baseline: I’d scraped together some secondhand gear at a bargain price after a few rounds of haggling. I couldn’t even afford a decent supply of the cheapest potions. The most I could handle was a few dozen small monsters in the dark, damp caves inside the subspaces known as Gates.
hunks.sol: I’d armed myself with secondhand gear bought cheap after several rounds of haggling. I couldn’t afford to stock up on even the cheapest potions. All I could handle were the dark, damp caves in the subspaces known as Gates—and the few dozen small monsters I’d encounter inside them.

hunks.baseline: A sticky, hot sensation brushed my cheek.
hunks.sol: Something hot and sticky struck my cheek.

hunks.baseline: Once, that chilling touch would have made me flinch. Then the foul stench that crawled into my nose would have made me recoil again.
hunks.sol: Once, that chilling touch would have made me flinch. The foul smell that followed would have made me recoil all over again.

hunks.baseline: But that rookie Hunter, who’d thrown up at the horrible stench of blood he’d never smelled before, existed only in my memories now.
hunks.sol: But the rookie Hunter who’d thrown up at his first whiff of blood existed only in my memories now.

hunks.baseline: *Thrust!*
hunks.sol: *Shhk!*

hunks.baseline: I drove the blade into the throat of the enemy charging straight at me, twisted it, and yanked it free. Blood poured from the gaping wound.
hunks.sol: I drove my blade into the throat of an enemy charging straight at me, twisted it, and yanked it free. Blood poured from the gaping wound.

hunks.baseline: But to the fanatics, intoxicated by the strength of the Temporary Strength Pills and years of brainwashing, their comrade’s gruesome death was martyrdom—and just another chance to exploit an opening in my guard.
hunks.sol: But to the fanatics, drunk on years of brainwashing and the strength of the Temporary Strength Pills, their comrade’s gruesome death was martyrdom—and another chance to catch me off guard.

hunks.baseline: Blood-red Sword Energy rained down from every direction. The dense, destructive energy tangled together like a net, covering my entire body.
hunks.sol: Blood-red Sword Energy rained down from every direction. The dense, destructive strands tangled together like a net and closed over my entire body.

hunks.baseline: As I spun, the iron sword in my hand traced a perfect, deadly arc.
hunks.sol: I spun, and the iron sword in my hand traced a perfect, deadly arc.

hunks.baseline: The world—and everything in my sight—was red.
hunks.sol: Everything I could see. The whole world.

hunks.baseline: Yet even now, all my senses and bodily functions kept working without pause.
hunks.sol: Yet even now, every sense and every part of my body kept working without pause.

hunks.baseline: Everything caught in the slanted path of my sword split apart.
hunks.sol: Everything caught in the diagonal sweep of my sword split apart.

hunks.baseline: As I crossed the rising mound of corpses, sticky blood and screams—darker still—spilled around my feet.
hunks.sol: I crossed the rising mound of corpses, and in my wake, sticky blood and screams darker still spilled over it.

hunks.baseline: *Thwack! Thrust-thrust!*
hunks.sol: *Thwack! Shhk-shhk!*

hunks.baseline: I cut, stabbed, and smashed without pause.
hunks.sol: I cut, stabbed, and hacked without pause.

hunks.baseline: It didn’t matter what I held in my hands.
hunks.sol: It didn’t matter what I held.

hunks.baseline: An axe, a sword, or some oddly shaped weapon like a mace or a scythe—all of them were, at their core, weapons meant to kill.
hunks.sol: An axe, a sword, even an oddly shaped weapon like a mace or a scythe—all of them were made to kill.

hunks.baseline: The weapons that had been left deep in Xining’s armory, rusting red, became masterworks imbued with a craftsman’s blood and sweat the moment they landed in my hands. They might break against Sword Energy, but they still fulfilled their purpose.
hunks.sol: The weapons left to rust deep in Xining’s armory became masterworks steeped in a craftsman’s blood and sweat the moment they landed in my hands. They might break against Sword Energy, but they fulfilled their purpose to the end.

hunks.baseline: By taking the lives of my enemies, just as their new owner intended.
hunks.sol: They took my enemies’ lives, just as their owner intended.

hunks.baseline: The enemies surrounding me on all sides, and the shouts of my allies raining down from the wall above, filled the air.
hunks.sol: Shouts rang out from the enemies surrounding me and the allies on the wall above.

hunks.baseline: But I couldn’t even make out what they were saying.
hunks.sol: But I couldn’t make out what any of them were saying.

hunks.baseline: My ears, which should have been taking in every sound with razor-sharp senses, felt muffled. The world before my eyes moved so slowly it was almost boring, yet every detail was crystal clear.
hunks.sol: My ears felt muffled, though my senses were sharp enough to catch every sound. The world before my eyes moved so slowly it was almost boring, yet every detail was clear.

hunks.baseline: I had no idea how many enemies I’d taken down, or how many weapons I’d broken.
hunks.sol: I had no idea how many enemies I’d taken down or how many weapons I’d broken.

hunks.baseline: I was climbing another step toward a new realization.
hunks.sol: I was climbing toward another moment of enlightenment.

hunks.baseline: Wrapped in a fog of No-self, forgetting not only the situation around me but even myself, I moved through a battlefield where life and death hung in the balance.
hunks.sol: Wrapped in a fog of No-self, forgetting not only what was happening around me but even myself, I moved through a battlefield where life and death hung in the balance.

hunks.baseline: As if bewitched, I kept muttering the words in my heart.
hunks.sol: As if bewitched, I kept repeating the words to myself.

hunks.baseline: A sensation, impossible to tell whether it was pain or pleasure, ran down my spine like an electric current.
hunks.sol: A sensation I couldn’t tell from pain or pleasure ran down my spine like an electric current.

hunks.baseline: Now the sensation of Trance was more intense than ever, taking over my entire body.
hunks.sol: Now the Trance was more intense than ever, taking over my entire body.

hunks.baseline: As though they’d heard the quiet whisper that echoed only in my heart, the enemies charged at me as one. They recited those eight words, that curse disguised as a creed—“Heaven above and earth below, all demons bow!”—then roared and lashed out with the weapons in their hands, putting all their strength behind each blow.
hunks.sol: As though they’d heard the quiet whisper in my mind, the enemies charged at me as one. They recited those eight words, that curse of a creed—“Heaven above and earth below, all demons bow!”—then roared and swung their weapons with all their might.

hunks.baseline: And in that same instant, every one of them became a lonely soul.
hunks.sol: In the same instant, every one of them became a lonely soul.

hunks.baseline: Everything split apart as I strode forward without hesitation.
hunks.sol: Everything split apart as I strode forward.

hunks.baseline: There was no sea before me, but the blood the enemies spilled surged like waves. It was another kind of Red Sea.
hunks.sol: There was no sea before me, but the blood pouring from my enemies surged like waves. It was another kind of Red Sea.

hunks.baseline: Instinct gradually layered over my fading reason.
hunks.sol: Instinct spread over my fading reason.

hunks.baseline: Without even looking, I dodged the blade swung at me from behind. With one sweep, I cut down five enemies charging from the side and the front.
hunks.sol: Without looking, I dodged a blade swung at me from behind. With one stroke, I cut down five enemies charging from the side and the front.

hunks.baseline: I suddenly wanted this dreamlike sensation to last forever. This dream belonged only to me, and it was the sweetest sleep I’d ever known.
hunks.sol: I wanted this dreamlike feeling to last forever. This dream belonged to me alone, and it was the sweetest sleep I’d ever known.

hunks.baseline: Even if I woke from it, I’d sell my soul just to see this story through to the end.
hunks.sol: Even if I had to wake, I would have sold my soul to see how this story ended.

hunks.baseline: If I could make the insight that drew closer with every step my own, I could fall into this same sweet sleep whenever I wanted.
hunks.sol: If I could make the insight drawing closer with every step my own, I could fall into this same sweet sleep whenever I wanted.

hunks.baseline: If there was someone dreaming, then there was someone who could wake them.
hunks.sol: Where there was a dreamer, there could also be someone to wake them.

hunks.baseline: Through ears that had been receiving every sound around me as a distant echo came the sharp whistle of something cutting through the air.
hunks.sol: A sharp whistle cut through the distant echo that every other sound had become.

hunks.baseline: The fury in it, the enormous force drawing nearer by the second, dragged me out of my dream and threw me into reality.
hunks.sol: The ferocity in it, the enormous force drawing closer by the moment, dragged me out of my dream and hurled me into reality.

hunks.baseline: Along with someone’s urgent, unfinished shout, suddenly bursting from somewhere in the open air.
hunks.sol: Someone shouted an urgent warning from somewhere in the air, but the words broke off midway.

hunks.baseline: At the same time, a blood-red flash hurtled toward me from far away, its dazzling glimmer staining my vision with a sticky red.
hunks.sol: At the same time, a blood-red flash hurtled toward me from far away, its dazzling light staining my vision a thick red.

hunks.baseline: My eyes flew open before I knew it. A red alarm rang in my mind, whispering:
hunks.sol: My eyes widened. An alarm blared in my head, whispering:

hunks.baseline: *It’s too late. You can’t dodge this.*
hunks.sol: *Too late. You can’t dodge it.*

hunks.baseline: The flash shot toward me with such terrifying speed, and I’d been thrown straight from a sweet dream into reality so abruptly that I couldn’t move fast enough to keep up.
hunks.sol: The flash was terrifyingly fast. Torn from that sweet sleep and thrown straight into reality, I couldn’t move quickly enough to evade it.

hunks.baseline: Unlike whoever had warned me of the danger half a beat earlier—someone who might have been watching over me the whole time.
hunks.sol: Unlike the person who’d warned me half a beat earlier—who might have been watching over me all along.

hunks.baseline: In the slowed-down world, the figure of a person falling through the air appeared on my retinas.
hunks.sol: In the slowed-down world, I saw someone drop through the air.

hunks.baseline: A snow-white blade blocked the flash, which was already almost at my nose. Violet Sword Force scattered around it like flower petals.
hunks.sol: A snow-white blade blocked the flash, now almost upon me. Violet Sword Force scattered around it like flower petals.

hunks.baseline: In the dusty haze that covered everything, Jin Taekyung blinked dazedly and wondered:
hunks.sol: In the pale dust cloud that covered everything, Jin Taekyung gave a dry cough, blinked dazedly, and wondered:

hunks.baseline: The question surfaced in his mind.
The answer came right away.
hunks.sol: The answer came at once.

hunks.baseline: Small and large pains pricked through his whole body, accompanied by a System alert only he could hear.
hunks.sol: Pains large and small stabbed through his body like needles, accompanied by a System alert only he could hear.

hunks.baseline: No—warning sirens was the more accurate description.
hunks.sol: No—*warning sirens* would be more accurate.

hunks.baseline: *Beep! Beep!*
hunks.sol: *Beep! Beep-beep!*

hunks.baseline: Trying to ignore the sirens that kept drilling into his ears, Jin Taekyung struggled to his feet.
hunks.sol: Trying to ignore the sirens drilling into his ears, Jin Taekyung struggled to his feet.

hunks.baseline: *Rumble.*
hunks.sol: *Pat-pat.*

hunks.baseline: Heavy. Painful.
hunks.sol: He felt heavy. Everything hurt.

hunks.baseline: Maybe it was because he’d suddenly woken from a Trance in which every sense had been pushed to its limit.
hunks.sol: Maybe it was because he’d been wrenched from a Trance in which every sense had been pushed to its limit.

hunks.baseline: His body sagged like cotton soaked with water. But despite the barrage of warning sirens, he didn’t seem to have any serious injuries.
hunks.sol: His body sagged like waterlogged cotton. But despite the barrage of warning sirens, he didn’t seem to have any serious injuries.

hunks.baseline: Of course, he had someone to thank for that: the person who’d blocked the flash in his place at the last moment.
hunks.sol: He had the person who’d blocked the flash for him at the last moment to thank for that.

hunks.baseline: His tired, cracked voice slipped past his lips. But in the dust cloud, so thick he couldn’t see a hand in front of his face, all he heard were groans from people he couldn’t identify.
hunks.sol: His voice came out tired and cracked. In the dust cloud, too thick to see a step ahead, only unidentifiable groans answered him.

hunks.baseline: When no answer came, even after he’d called several times, a foreboding feeling crept over him.
hunks.sol: He called several more times. When no answer came, dread crept over him.

hunks.baseline: Jin Taekyung took a deep breath and flung out the sleeve that had already been torn to shreds.
hunks.sol: Jin Taekyung took a deep breath and swept out his arm, its sleeve already torn to shreds.

hunks.baseline: Compressed air exploded. A gust imbued with internal energy swept away part of the dense dust cloud, and the scene hidden beyond it finally came into view.
hunks.sol: Compressed air exploded outward. A gust imbued with internal energy drove away some of the dust, revealing what lay beyond it.

hunks.baseline: A gaping hole in the city wall, wide enough for five grown men to stand shoulder to shoulder, and allies sprawled everywhere, groaning in pain.
hunks.sol: A gaping hole in the city wall, wide enough for five grown men to stand shoulder to shoulder. Allies lay sprawled all around it, groaning in pain.

hunks.baseline: But even now, there was no sign of Cheongpung.
hunks.sol: But there was still no sign of Cheongpung.

hunks.baseline: Then he stretched out his hand toward the enemies charging through the ruins of the broken wall and the dust cloud.
hunks.sol: Then he reached toward the enemies charging through the fallen wall and the dust.

hunks.baseline: It pierced through every obstacle in its way.
hunks.sol: It pierced every obstacle in its path.

hunks.baseline: A fountain of blood surged up.
hunks.sol: Blood spouted into the air.

hunks.baseline: Dozens of enemies who’d been charging with their spirits high fell like rotten logs. Taking advantage of the opening, the allies formed ranks and fought with all their might to close the gap.
hunks.sol: Dozens of enemies, their spirits high as they charged, fell like rotten logs. In that brief opening, the allies formed ranks and fought with all their might to fill the gap.

hunks.baseline: *Clang!*
hunks.sol: *Clang-clang!*

hunks.baseline: *Thrust!*
hunks.sol: *Shhk!*

hunks.baseline: And even as the melee broke out around the breached wall, Jin Taekyung cut down enemies with all his strength, shouting one person’s name.
hunks.sol: Even as the melee broke out around the breached wall, Jin Taekyung cut down enemies with all his strength and shouted one person’s name.

hunks.baseline: Only the screams and shouts of friend and foe alike rang out all around him. That damned innocent voice was nowhere to be heard.
hunks.sol: Only the screams and shouts of friend and foe rang out around him. That damned innocent voice was nowhere to be heard.

hunks.baseline: His heart thundered in his chest, and every moment made it harder to breathe.
hunks.sol: His heart pounded like thunder. With every moment, it grew harder to breathe.

hunks.baseline: Cheongpung—he wasn’t the kind of guy who’d go down this easily.
hunks.sol: Cheongpung wasn’t the kind of guy who’d go down this easily.

hunks.baseline: Like the hero in a fairy tale, he’d somehow survive and live happily ever after.
hunks.sol: Like the hero in a fairy tale, he’d find some way to survive and live happily ever after.

hunks.baseline: Why did this inexplicable unease keep growing heavier and darker?
hunks.sol: Why did this inexplicable dread keep growing heavier and darker?

hunks.baseline: With a shout full of rage, Jin Taekyung charged toward the enemy.
hunks.sol: Jin Taekyung charged with a furious shout.

hunks.baseline: It was anger at the invaders who’d caused all this—but also blame directed at himself, the idiot who’d been consumed by a single-minded pursuit of enlightenment.
hunks.sol: He was angry at the invaders who’d caused all this—and at himself, the idiot who’d been consumed by his pursuit of enlightenment.

hunks.baseline: And the dazzling point of his spear, cutting through the enemy and raising a storm of blood, was drawing closer to one person approaching at a leisurely pace.
hunks.sol: As he tore through the enemy in a storm of blood, the dazzling point of his spear drew closer to a man approaching at a slow walk.
